## Frequently asked questions

Is there an annual discount?

If you sign up for a full year, you get two months free!

If you're already on a monthly plan and want to change, you can update your plan in the billing portal.

Can I cancel at any time?

Yes. There is a simple button to press to cancel your subscription at any time.

What if I'm unsatisfied with the service?

OnlineOrNot offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on all of its plans.

If at any time you're unhappy with the service, contact max@onlineornot.com, and I'll immediately refund you.

Do I have to sign a contract or long-term commitment?

No. You can use any of OnlineOrNot's plans on a month-to-month basis. If OnlineOrNot isn't for you, you can cancel at any time.

I don't have time to enter all of my URLs, can you help?

Yes!

Send max@onlineornot.com a list of the URLs you want monitored, and I will upload it into to your account, for free!

What if I have an unfrequently asked question?

You can ask me anything at max@onlineornot.com
